target_customer: Early-stage and mid-sized B2B sales teams without a dedicated deal desk
problem: Growing startups need custom terms and approvals but enterprise CPQ tools are heavy and slow to implement.
business_model: B2B SaaS priced on active contracts, free for early founders

founders.name: Simon Ooley
founders.background_notes: Sales and sales leadership roles per YC page.

founders.name: Patrick Koperwas
education: UCSB, Machine Learning and Applied Statistics
founders.background_notes: Early employee at Procore and Tegus.

technical_complexity.rationale: Pricing rules, approvals and CRM sync are standard SaaS engineering; agent features add moderate difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: CRM integration and pricing book configuration add some lock-in, but incumbents and PandaDoc-style tools overlap.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not sourced at batch time; a vendor blog says Salesforce stopped selling legacy CPQ to new customers in March 2025.

market_need_then: Founders describe duct-taping spreadsheets to CRM once deals need custom terms; the YC launch post positions Veles as a cheaper alternative to enterprise CPQ.

identity.voice_and_tone: Founder-led and plain: 'Agents do the CPQ work'; CEO says he reads every email

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; the name shares with a Slavic god and unrelated firms, and a prefix .com.

outcome_analysis: Veles is active with a team of five and claims over 4,000 users and customers including Procore, where the founders previously worked. Funding is only supported by aggregators with totals from 500K to 1.42M, so the funding path is unclear. The product pivoted its framing toward agents, but timing of that shift is not dated.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights says 500K over 6 rounds, Caplight 1.42M, Extruct and Standout about 730K; dates conflict (Nov 2023, Feb 2024, May 2024). No company announcement found, so no round recorded. Competition list empty because sources are 2026 vendor pages, not dated near the batch. Founder education mostly not listed.
